title: feat(runtime/selfemit): RFC061 §M8 SELFEMIT-FCNTL — x86_64-linux ELF hxlcl_fcntl native .o (HEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL, default-OFF)
body: feat(runtime): extend the darwin-arm64 SELFEMIT `fcntl` member to x86_64-linux via a self-contained ELF64 ET_REL emitter. NEW test/native_build/emit_hxlcl_fcntl_elf_o.hexa clones the strlen ELF fixture (emit_hxlcl_strlen_elf_o.hexa) — x86_64 arm emits the 8-byte class-C 3-arg NON-errno syscall leaf `mov eax,72; syscall; ret` (b8 48 00 00 00 / 0f 05 / c3; SYS_fcntl=72, C args rdi/rsi/rdx pass straight through to the kernel, no register shuffle), exports ONE strong global `hxlcl_fcntl` (bare, no `_`), NO reloc / NO errno provider / NO external callee (mirrors the darwin no-_cf leaf which likewise returns the raw trap result). arm64 = FAIL (arm64-linux fcntl is SYS 25 / svc #0, distinct from the darwin SYS 92 / svc #0x80 bytes — next rung). tool/stage_resolve_runtime_a: new SELFEMIT-FCNTL block after the SELFEMIT-STRLEN `fi` (:1645), gated `HEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL=1 && Linux && x86_64|amd64` (x86_64-only like RT-NATIVE-FMOD :1704); on success appends -DHEXA_RT_SELFEMIT_FCNTL to _mo_shim_def + build/hxlcl_fcntl_native.o to _mo_hxlcl_members; the shim #ifndef guard already exists (self/runtime_core_hxlcl_shim_emit.hexa:1415). CO-DROP verified SAFE: fcntl is absent from the CO-DROP registry (:1562), the MEMLEAF list (:1668), and has NO RT-NATIVE-FCNTL block, so _mo_rtnative_syms can never contain 'fcntl' → exactly ONE provider, zero ld -r multidef risk (defensive case-skip added anyway for forward-safety, no-op today); no registry entry added (no seed to mirror per selfemit-smoke-4591-codrop-default-mismatch). DEFAULT-OFF (unset) → block + elif both skipped → _mo_shim_def / _mo_hxlcl_members unchanged → shim.o + runtime.a byte-identical (sha f2d507e1 / 151c52c8 invariant). Gate (pool aiden/summer): (1) byteeq 3-target default-OFF vs frozen; (2) member .text objdump == clang --target=x86_64-linux-gnu oracle b8 48 00 00 00 0f 05 c3; (3) LINK smoke flag-ON — ld -r multidef=0, hexa build exit42, fcntl(F_GETFL) parity vs libc. bash -n GREEN.

title: perf(runtime): heapify watermark fast-reject — 12.8x lower_ast_to_hir (flag-OFF·rung#1b)

Census measured lower_ast_to_hir=371s (86% of self-emit residual after rung#1a). Root: hexa_val_heapify TAG_ARRAY arm re-walked every element on every __hexa_fn_arena_return -> O(depth^2) (array-push FALSIFIED as already O(1) amortized; TAG_STR already had an O(1) envelope reject, TAG_ARRAY did not). title: fix(check HEXA-OWN round12): HX3019 E0515 projection FP guard — reference-typed param base (return &p.x, p:&P) no longer flagged (opt-in HEXA_BORROWCK, byte-neutral)
body: adversarial-review FP fix on the round12 E0515 projection rung(#4b375bd57): `return &p.x` where `p: &P`(reference-typed PARAM)를 잘못 HX3019로 flag했음. rustc는 ACCEPT — `&p.x`는 p의 referent(caller가 제공, call보다 오래 삼) lifetime을 carry하지 캘리 function-local escape가 아님. base-walk head=`p`이고 `_mir_lookup_global(p)<0`(param은 global 아님)→가드 없으면 fire했고, HEXA_BORROWCK_STRICT=1에서 canonical accessor 패턴(`return &self.field`/`return &p.field`)을 build-refusing Error로 re-band→대량 valid code 파손. fix=hir_to_mir.hexa: (1)module-lifetime ref-param registry `_bck_refp_fns`/`_bck_refp_names` 신설(@own pre-pass 옆, `param_names` annotation×`sig_params` index-align 워크, kind가 `named:&`로 시작=`&P`/`&mut P` borrow type=ast_to_hir `_hir_lower_type_ref` name-fold), lower_hir 진입 시 own arrays와 lockstep reset, `_bck_on` gate. (2)helper `_bck_is_ref_param(fn,name)`. (3)projection arm emit 조건에 `&& !_bck_is_ref_param(_bck_cur_fn, _bk_head.text)` 추가. SOUNDNESS: PARAM만 excuse — ref-typed LOCAL(`let r=&loc`)은 referent가 function-local일 수 있어 skip하면 unsound false-negative→절대 안 excuse. bare-ident HX3019 arm(`return &p`, p:&P)은 p slot 자체를 borrow→rustc도 E0515→버그 없음(scope 밖). direct-form/owned-param(`p:P`)/owned-local projection은 registry에 없어 계속 fire. byte-neutral: registry population+emit-guard 모두 `_bck_active`/`_bck_on` gate→default-OFF diag stream+.text 불변(gen3≡gen4). test=borrowck_test.hexa +1 control `fp_ret_proj_refparam`(`fn rprp(p:&P)->&i64{return &p.x}`)=HX3019 ×0; 기존 hz field/index/nested ×1 유지. catalog HX3019 explain에 ref-param 제외 문서화(reference PARAM만·ref-typed LOCAL 아님).
